description: Post a living chart to a destination at a fixed time, daily or weekly (e.g. every Monday at 08:00 UTC), with its latest data. Calling it again for the same chart and destination replaces the schedule. To send whenever the data changes use send_chart_on_update. Returns a confirmation. Needs a connection signed in to a free account (connector URL ending in /mcp/account).

destination_id.description: The destination id from add_destination or list_my_charts.

hour.description: Hour of the day in UTC (default 8).

id.description: The chart id from create_living_chart or list_my_charts.

on_update.description: Also send whenever the data changes.

name: schedule_chart
title: Schedule chart delivery
